end.summary:
Om identified standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines across practice examples; this was shown with a why or new-situation question.
Om practised telling straight lines from curved lines; easy questions were answered correctly, with a why or new-situation check still needed next time.
Om briefly mixed up the meaning of “straight” and “standing,” then identified a sleeping line using the table-edge example.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines with Om. Om used useful reasons such as “does not bend” and “goes side to side”; they briefly mixed up “straight” with “standing,” then corrected this by describing a sleeping line as moving side to side. At home, ask Om to find one standing, one sleeping, one slanting, and one curved line, and ask how they know.
